capabilities: Convert .txt and .vtt transcript files into Markdown notes via a command
Watch a folder and auto-convert new transcript files as they appear
Render WebVTT cues as bulleted lists with optional computed timestamps
Detect Microsoft Teams exports and convert them speaker by speaker
Generate YAML frontmatter with meeting name, date, duration, and participants
extras: The manifest carries the notice "This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff." Desktop-only; manual installation only, with no community plugin store listing instructions.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn raw meeting transcript exports into readable, consistently named Markdown notes.

relations.evidence: Built for meeting transcripts (Zoom recordings and Microsoft Teams exports)
Microsoft Teams transcripts — Teams exports are detected automatically and converted speaker by speaker

summary: Converter that turns .txt and .vtt meeting transcripts (Zoom, Microsoft Teams) into cleaned Markdown notes with frontmatter, entirely offline.
